title: SB2788 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 38; Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13 and Title 49, relative to firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2024-02-01; official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260514144230 of https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/113/Bill/SB2788.pdf (LegiScan doc 2911510))
provenance.note: Draft (2024-02-01), as introduced; no amendments in the text read. Effective July 1, 2024. SECTION 5 (TCA 39-17-1350(c)(1)) and SECTION 8 are related notice and cross-reference changes, not quoted.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1309(e)(1)(B)): (B) Active duty and retired members of the armed forces of the United States possessing or carrying a handgun in any public pre-kindergarten through grade twelve (pre-K-12) school building or bus, on any public pre-kindergarten through grade twelve (pre-K-12) school campus, grounds, recreation area, athletic field, or any other property owned, operated, or while in use by any public board of education or pre-kindergarten through grade twelve (pre-K-12) school, unless the person is otherwise prohibited from possessing or carrying a handgun by state or federal law;
SECTION 2 (TCA 39-17-1309(e)(4)(B)): (B) Officers of the state, or of any county, city, or town, charged with the enforcement of the laws of this state, whether on-duty or off-duty, possessing or carrying a handgun, or retired law enforcement officers possessing or carrying a handgun who are authorized to carry the handgun pursuant to §§ 38-8-116 and 39-17-1315, while in any public pre-kindergarten through grade twelve (pre-K-12) school building or bus, on any public pre-kindergarten through grade twelve (pre-K-12) school campus, grounds,
SECTION 2 (TCA 39-17-1309(e)(4)(B), continued after page break): recreation area, athletic field, or any other property owned, operated, or while in use by any public board of education or pre-kindergarten through grade twelve (pre-K-12) school;
SECTION 3 (TCA 39-17-1309(e)(8)(B)(i)): Persons possessing or carrying a handgun, who are authorized to carry the handgun pursuant to § 39-17-1351, while in any public pre-kindergarten through grade twelve (pre-K-12) school building or bus, on any public pre-kindergarten through grade twelve (pre-K-12) school campus, grounds, recreation area, athletic field, or any other property owned, operated, or while in use by any public board of education or pre-kindergarten through grade twelve (pre-K-12) school.
SECTION 4 (TCA 39-17-1309(e)(10)): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1309, is amended by deleting subdivision (e)(10).
SECTION 6 (TCA 49-6-815): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 49-6-815, is amended by deleting the section.
SECTION 7 (TCA 49-6-816): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 49-6-816, is amended by deleting the section.
